description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Http Ato FxCat1 object, related to HTTP protocol handling within a specific module, including creation of code and name tables and retrieval of atom codes and names.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1CreateCodeTable
methods.description: Creates a code table used internally by the Http Ato FxCat1 object.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1CreateNameTable
methods.description: Creates a name table used internally by the Http Ato FxCat1 object.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1GetAtomCode
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code for a given name.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1GetAtomName
methods.description: Retrieves the atom name for a given code.
